svg.text: Remote-access VPN: AWS Client VPN vs OpenVPN vs WireGuard
One private target, three ways in — managed mutual-TLS endpoint vs two self-hosted servers on EC2, verified from an unrelated VPC
Key material, policy and logs (setup-pki.sh creates keys outside CloudFormation)
All three source-NAT into the VPC; the target security group admits only the three VPN security groups.
